sources.entry: Shotnix - Screenshot and screen recording app for the menu bar with annotation, pinned screenshots, scrolling capture, OCR, and a video editor.

summary.one_liner: Shotnix is a free, open-source, native Swift menu bar app for macOS that takes screenshots, records screen video, and includes a built-in video editor.
keywords: record screen with voice and camera
summary.what_it_does: Shotnix captures areas, windows, fullscreen, all displays, or a scrolling long page, with an optional 3/5/10-second countdown. After each capture a quick access overlay offers copy, save, edit, pin, and close. The annotation editor provides arrows, shapes, text, numbered steps, spotlight, highlighter, and blur or pixelate tools, plus crop with undo. Screen recording captures an area, window, or display at 60 fps with system audio, microphone, and camera, and supports pause, resume, and crash recovery. The built-in video editor adds zooms on clicks, a smoothed cursor, captions, background music, title cards, and exports to MP4 up to 4K or GIF. OCR, QR and barcode scanning, and a searchable capture history are also included.
use_cases: take a screenshot of part of the screen and annotate it
record a polished product demo on a Mac
capture a long web page as one image
extract text from an image on screen
find an old screenshot by the text inside it
pin a reference screenshot on the desktop
add captions and zooms to a screen recording
notable: Captions and text recognition run on the Mac, with no account, cloud, or analytics
Scrolling capture stitches a long page into one tall image
Recordings survive crashes and are recovered on the next launch
Search screenshot history by the text inside captures
Localized into English, German, French, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Ukrainian, and Japanese
caveats: Requires macOS 13 or later and Swift 5.9 or later to build from source
Some features need newer systems: translation for captions needs macOS 15+, and WebP export depends on system support
Scrolling, OCR, all-displays, timed, and recording actions have no default hotkey and must be assigned in Settings
